comments.name: 锦绣华章

comments.name: GlobalCitizen
comments.content: The US-China relationship is still so complex, '相敬如宾' is just a facade, you know. Both sides are playing hardball, and the underlying tensions are very real. And this AI disorder, it's a critical global concern, far beyond just Trump's 'new hegemony.' It demands serious international collaboration for regulation. Singapore's economy is always impressive, definitely a good benchmark for resilience and forward-thinking policies. Hong Kong's higher ed crisis is really sad to see, it used to be such a regional academic hub. Hope they can find a way to recover and thrive again. 🤦‍♀️
